purpose: Make the current JPFM-4A frontier recoverable without repeating completed Bumper, biomedical, NTRS/NSSDC or GCAT work after a conversation/tool interruption.

authority_boundary.rule: This index points to evidence and gates; it does not promote any human-made explanation of POSS-I or Blue Book observations.

repaired_interruption.break_location: The Bumper Cape-phase manifest and manually recorded calibration result existed, but a deterministic replay/verifier chain from the pinned Blue Book and POSS-I workflow artifacts had not been completed.
repaired_interruption.conclusion: The previously stored Bumper calibration result was reproduced from pinned input artifacts. The interruption was a reproducibility-tail failure, not a lost scientific result.
